strings.studio/pm/migrate/intro: This project uses format {from}, and this Studio uses {to}. Before saving, the Studio keeps a copy of all files in .vnstudio/backups/.
strings.studio/pm/migrate/confirm: I understand this update deletes project data and that the copy is kept in .vnstudio/backups/
strings.studio/error/too_new: This project was made with a newer version of the Studio (format {version}). Update Visual Novel Studio to open it.
strings.studio/error/choose_folder: Choose where to create the project.
strings.studio/error/invalid_locale: "{locale}" is not a valid language code (e.g. pt-BR, en, ja).
strings.studio/error/folder_not_empty: The chosen folder already has files ({names}). Choose an empty folder.
strings.studio/error/not_a_project: This folder has no project.json. Choose the folder of a Visual Novel Studio project.
strings.studio/error/invalid_json: The project.json in this folder is not valid JSON.
strings.studio/error/file_invalid_json: {file} is not valid JSON; fix the file before updating the project.
strings.studio/error/cannot_migrate: This Studio does not know how to update projects from format {from}.x to {to}.0.
strings.studio/error/not_confirmed: This update deletes project data and needs explicit confirmation.
strings.studio/project/newer_minor: This project was saved by a newer Studio (format {version}). Fields this version does not know may be lost when editing; update the Studio when you can.
